mise () 
{ 
    local command;
    command="${1:-}";
    if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then
        command "$__MISE_EXE";
        return;
    fi;
    shift;
    case "$command" in 
        deactivate | shell | sh)
            if [[ ! " $* " =~ " --help " ]] && [[ ! " $* " =~ " -h " ]]; then
                eval "$(command "$__MISE_EXE" "$command" "$@")";
                return $?;
            fi
        ;;
    esac;
    command "$__MISE_EXE" "$command" "$@"
}
